ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The Abu Simbel Temple (24°N) located beside the Nile River (lower left figure) was built from 1300 BC to 1233 BC. Every year, only on the two days of Ramses II's birthday and foundation day can the rays of the rising sun enter through the temple gate, pass through the 60m-deep temple corridor, and shine over the whole body of the colossal stone statue of Ramses II at the end of the temple (lower right figure). People call the dates on which this strange phenomenon occurs the “Sun Festival.” Read the figures and answer: If Ramses II's birthday is February 21, then on what month and day is the foundation day? <image1>

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: the left figure shows the front entrance of the Abu Simbel Temple, and the entrance position and the building direction of the temple are fixed; the right figure shows the stone statue deep inside the temple being illuminated by strong light entering from outside, indicating that the Sun Festival phenomenon requires the rising sun to enter along the fixed direction of the temple gate and temple corridor. Then reason: the question stem gives that the location is at 24°N, and that only on the two days of the birthday and foundation day in a year can the rising sun illuminate the end of the temple corridor. Because the direction of the temple passage is fixed, the condition for entering the temple gate is that the sunrise azimuth is the same; at the same latitude, the sunrise azimuth is determined by the solar declination, so the two Sun Festivals should correspond to the same solar declination. February 21 is after the winter solstice and before the spring equinox; the solar declination is southern declination and is increasing. According to the symmetry of the annual change of solar declination, the other date with the same declination as February 21 is after the autumn equinox and before the winter solstice, and is roughly symmetrical around the winter solstice, corresponding to October 21. Therefore the foundation day is October 21.
